title: Eliminate WP Spec Files
outcome_summary: Eliminated the redundant work/WP-###.md spec files and work.md summary index from the entire ledger workflow across MCP server source, tests, all nine agent personas, the Bootstrapper support persona, and the orchestrator integration test. The work_package_file field was removed from all schemas and tools, description was made a required field in CreateWorkPackageSchema, and every agent persona was updated to use ledger_get_work_package as the sole source of WP specification content. All 6 WPs completed all 4 pipeline stages with zero regressions; the test suite grew by one net new validation test (4020 passing) and 126 persona files built cleanly.
project_summary: This project eliminates the redundant work/WP-###.md spec files and work.md summary index from the ledger workflow. All WP specification content is already available via the ledger_get_work_package tool, making the file-based copies a token-wasting synchronization burden. The plan removes spec file creation from the Bootstrapper, removes the work_package_file field from all MCP schemas and tools, makes description required, and updates all agent personas to use the ledger as the sole source of WP content.
